mapper.select: SELECT * FROM contract ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT c.* FROM contract c WHERE c.id = ( SELECT c2.id FROM contract c2 WHERE c2.institution_no = c.institution_no ORDER BY CASE c2.contract_status WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CASE c2.contract_status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN ABS(DATEDIFF(c2.sign_date, CURDATE())) WHEN 'INACTIVE' THEN ABS(DATEDIFF(c2.expire_date, CURDATE())) ELSE 0 END LIMIT 1 ) ORDER BY c.institution_no

SELECT i.id as institutionId, i.institution_no as institutionNo, i.institution_name as institutionName, i.region as region, c.id as contractId, c.contract_no as contractNo, c.contract_amount as contractAmount, c.sign_date as signDate, c.expire_date as expireDate, c.responsible_person as responsiblePerson, c.contract_status as contractStatus, c.remark as remark FROM institution i LEFT JOIN ( SELECT c2.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY c2.institution_no ORDER BY CASE c2.contract_status WHEN 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CASE c2.contract_status WHEN 'PENDING' THEN ABS(DATEDIFF(c2.sign_date, CURDATE())) WHEN 'INACTIVE' THEN ABS(DATEDIFF(c2.expire_date, CURDATE())) ELSE 0 END ) as rn FROM contract c2 ) c ON i.institution_no = c.institution_no AND c.rn = 1 WHERE i.institution_status = 'NORMAL' ORDER BY i.institution_no LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM institution WHERE institution_status = 'NORMAL'
SELECT * FROM contract WHERE institution_no = #{institutionNo} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO contract (contract_no, institution_no, contract_amount, sign_date, expire_date, responsible_person, contract_status, remark) VALUES (#{contractNo}, #{institutionNo}, #{contractAmount}, #{signDate}, #{expireDate}, #{responsiblePerson}, #{contractStatus}, #{remark})
mapper.update: UPDATE contract SET contract_status = #{contractStatus} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(contract_no) FROM contract WHERE contract_no LIKE CONCAT(#{year}, #{region, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '%')
